title: Compose qualified architecture view projections
description: Derive the five semantic architecture perspectives from one interpreted captured model, preserving source qualification, ownership and explicit limits.
inputs: Captured interpreted definitions, typed relationships, realization facts and source identity.
Selected view scope and declared optional reading profiles.
outputs: Logical, Process, Development, Physical and Scenario projections with exact source references.
behavior: Reuse authoritative containment and relationships; derive inverse navigation without a second fact store.
Keep logical responsibility, runtime execution and physical placement distinct, and use sequence/activity/lifecycle order only from explicitly established source semantics.
Scope each topic by owner, facet, qualification, kind and local name; do not resolve collisions by display label or array position.
Omit repository-specific panels unless explicitly selected and supported; never require RigorLoop entity IDs in a customer model.
Expose absent optional detail and missing required explanation without inventing satisfaction, approval or complete design.

failure_behavior.condition: Required interpretation or references are invalid.
failure_behavior.outcome: Reject a successful new projection and preserve identified diagnostics.

failure_behavior.condition: A requested optional view has no authoritative detail.
failure_behavior.outcome: Return its explicit absent-detail result without fabricating facts.

sources.basis: System and Architecture Design from SR-084–088 and refined SR-060; proposed responsibility, contract and realization only. No implementation, platform qualification or product availability is established.
